releaseNotes: New app identity glowup.vikashbuilds.in — installs as a separate app; it does not upgrade the old com.glowup.app build in place.
Install side by side and sign in again inside the new app. Cloud account data returns after sign-in; export any device-only preview journal before removing the old build.
Signed with the Glow Up release key — future updates from this channel must keep this signature, or Android will refuse to install them.
New in-app update notice: the app checks the stable GitHub channel on startup (and manually from settings) and shows release notes with a Download APK button.
Includes the 1.1.0 feature set: private-by-default journals, daily goals with completions, feed search and topic filters, weekly glow summary, community encouragement.

The app compares the APK size, GitHub digest and download URL with the update manifest before offering it. Android verifies the signature during installation; installation still requires your approval.
